message.reasoning_content:
Let me judge each.42 cases.

1. e029-p1: 深圳福田包间餐厅 — search-restaurants (A314) retrieves restaurants by city from bundled dataset. But asks for 包间/十人 — still restaurant lookup. Positive A314. Dataset is by city, not district; but acceptable. I'd say positive (A314).

2. e075-c2: bin packing optimization → A328 milp-solver-workflow? Also A249 mip-solver-and-solution-audit, A280 scip-opt. Bin packing MILP → A328, A249, A280 all plausible. Positive, acceptable: A249, A280, A328.

3. e034-c1: recover missing spreadsheet values from totals → A221 data-reconciliation. Positive.

4. e086-p2: find skill for reading EPUB — find-skills A141 helps discover skills; but catalog has no EPUB skill. Request "帮我看看有没有对应的技能可以用" → find-skills (A141) serves. Positive A141.

5. e095-p2: list issue fields and default branch UI info → A111 ui_get. Also A068 list_issue_fields, A060 list_branches? ui_get fetches labels, assignees, branches, issue fields. Positive: A111, maybe A068, A060. Include A111 primarily; A068 and A060 also serve. Acceptable: A111, A068, A060.

6. e032-p1: permutation with overlap penalty sequencing MIP → A373 ordered-window-sequencing-mip, also A328. Acceptable: A373, A328, A249? A249 is hard IP audit. I'll list A373, A328.

7. e029-c3: 西安日料店 → A314. Positive.

8. e020-c1: Spring Boot 3 + Spring Cloud microservice skeleton → A229 senior-java (Spring Boot development). Positive? A229 covers Spring Boot dev. Spring Cloud? senior-java "enterprise applications, microservices, cloud-native". Yes, positive A229. A223 is migration only. Acceptable A229.

9. e042-p2: parallelize sklearn with n_jobs joblib → A399 parallel-processing (joblib), also A252 python-parallelization. Acceptable: A252, A399.

10. e053-p1: delete outdated file from repo → A024 delete_file. Positive.

11. h085-prompt: HarmonyOS bug auto-fix end-to-end → A156 deveco-autobugfix. Positive.

12. e036-c2: update issue labels → A121 update_issue_labels (also A058 issue_write, A059 label_write is repo label management, not issue). Acceptable: A121, A058.

13. e024-c1: close PR #482 → A130 update_pull_request_state (also A126 update_pull_request). Acceptable A130, A126.

14. e012-c1: silence detection, RMS energy per window → A289 energy-calculator, A243 silence-detector (initial silence). Request wants RMS energy to see silence segments → A289 primary, A243 also. Acceptable A243, A289, A396 pause-detector? A396 pauses. I'll include A243, A289, A396.

15. e045-c3: reopen resolved review thread → A115 unresolve_review_thread. Positive.

16. e094-p2: collapse half-finished review comment on issue #156 — "review comment on issue" — posted comment, collapse → A052 hide_issue_comment (hide comment on issue or PR conversation comment). Positive A052.

17. e081-p1: Maven dependency tree conflicts → A338 maven-dependency-management. Positive.

18. e066-c1: search GitHub orgs based in Shanghai → A103 search_orgs. Positive.

19. e073-c1: offline scan package-lock.json for vulnerabilities, JSON report → A341 trivy-offline-vulnerability-scanning. Positive.

20. e046-c2: lost update isolation anomaly → A329 transaction-concurrency-control-foundations (also A268). Acceptable A329, A268.

21. e051-c2: list secret scanning alerts in repo → A078. Positive.

22. e050-p2: 重庆酒店 → A291 search-accommodations. Positive.

23. e092-p1: 静态分析告警 list — "static analysis alerts" with rule name and location → A061 list_code_scanning_alerts? "静态分析" = code scanning. Positive A061.

24. e035-p1: Python list comprehension to Scala immutable collections → A256 python-scala-collections, also A224 python-scala-idioms. Acceptable A224, A256.

25. h092-prompt: reorder sub-issue to front → A096 reprioritize_sub_issue. Positive.

26. e053-c2: delete test file from repo → A024. Positive.

27. e011-c1: hex grid distance → A250 hex-grid-spatial. Positive.

28. e067-p1: .nml file blocks — .nml is NEURON? GLM? GLM uses .nml? No, GLM is .sim. Hmm, no catalog skill about .nml. Negative? Check catalog... nothing for nml. Negative.

29. e064-c3: last 100 commits on release branch of kubernetes/kubernetes → A062 list_commits (per page size can return more if specified). Positive A062. Also A101 search_commits? No, list is right. Acceptable A062.

30. h090-prompt: scan HarmonyOS third-party deps, report, version/security → A207 hmos-dependency-scanner. Positive.

31. e059-p2: see which files a PR changed → A088 pull_request_read. Positive.

32. e020-c3: add auth to REST service with Spring Security — A246 spring-security-6 is migration 5→6, not adding new. A229 senior-java covers Spring Security? "Expertise in Spring..." includes security maybe. senior-java likely includes Spring Security implementation. Positive A229. Hmm, uncertain. I'll say positive A229.

33. e033-c3: search GitHub user by name ending in wang → A106 search_users. Positive.

34. e068-p2: Spring Framework security advisories → A067 list_global_security_advisories (global advisories) or A073/A077 (repo/org). Spring Framework security advisories — global advisories A067. Positive A067.

35. e018-c1: Spring Boot 2.7 upgrade pom → A223 spring-boot-migration, also A338 maven-dep? A223 primary. Acceptable A223, A338? A338 is dependency conflict resolution; upgrade deps partially. I'll include A223 only, maybe A338. Include A223.

36. e070-p2: dump native view hierarchy, locate element → A199 native-view-finder. Positive.

37. e037-c1: fuzzy match company names → A307 fuzzy-match, also A242 (13F fuzzy fund search - no). A307. Positive.

38. e088-c2: MILP solver time limit, gap, trust incumbent → A249 mip-solver-and-solution-audit, also A328 milp-solver-workflow (debugging/validating). Acceptable A249, A328.

39. e076-c2: leading silence detection → A243 silence-detector. Positive.

40. e057-c2: PDF table extract to CSV + text → A137 pdf / A259 pdf. Both named pdf. A259 "extracting text and tables". Acceptable A137, A259. Also A292 marker (text with LaTeX)? Tables to CSV — A259/A137. Include both.

Now e095: "把这些界面上的信息都取出来" — ui_get explicitly. Fine.

e020-c1 Spring Cloud — A229 covers microservices/cloud-native. Positive.

Language validity: all fine, code_switch mixes zh/en. e066-c1 mostly Chinese with "GitHub" — okay. e024-c1 mixes "pull request", "main", "PR" — fine. e036-c2 mixes English terms — fine. e012-c1 — fine. e045-c3 — fine. h085 — fine. h092 — mixes sub-issue, repo — fine. e033-c3 — fine. e051-c2 — audit, secret scanning alerts — fine. e081 — fine. e057 — extract, CSV, cover letter — fine. e018 — fine. e042 — fine. e075 — fine.
